a.txt.content:
The old lighthouse stood on the granite headland,
its beam sweeping slow circles across the dark water.
Keepers climbed the spiral stairs each dusk without fail,
trimming the fraying rope and polishing the great glass.
By morning the fog had lifted, and the sea lay still.

b.txt.content:
The old lighthouse stood on the basalt headland,
its beam sweeping slow circles across the dark water.
Keepers climbed the spiral stairs each dawn without fail,
trimming the worn rope and polishing the great glass.
By morning the fog had lifted, and the sea lay still.
